verdict.rationale: Docs describe multimodal capability beyond text: Voxtral models for audio input and transcription, a flagship multimodal model card, an image-generation tool, and a Document Library RAG tool for uploaded documents, indicating the API accepts images, audio, and document inputs rather than being scoped to text-only. Community evidence on OCR (PDF and image processing) further corroborates document and image handling in practice. Missing for 10: a direct first-party API reference example showing how to pass an image or audio file in a chat request such as a base64 image payload format, and independent hands-on confirmation of image input since only OCR and audio-transcription use cases are corroborated.
